GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Slow Out 1 Lengths Not Bustled Settled Down last 9 Lengths held together well back to straightening up = task and now held-up Inside to he 250m, Kept Coming Closest on line, # forget ever ran
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 250m was briefly held up behind a weaking runner. When questioned, rdr stated that he had been given no specific instructions other than to have the mare travelling comfortably. He said that, after being slow to begin from the outside barrier, he was required to ride the mare at the rear of the field. He added that the mare was not suited by the tempo of the race through the middle stages, although he was of the view that its performance was still slightly disappointing.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned, rdr std from the outside barrier he remained racing wide down the back straight, which he felt was not a disadvantage. Std near the 800m he shifted closer to the field three-wide without cover. Std the mare came under pressure from the 500m and gave ground from the 400m, giving concern something may be amiss, so he eased final 200m. A post-race vet exam rev no abs other than the mare coughed. Co-tnr was advised a vet clearance including endoscopic results will be required before barrier trialling to the satisfiaction of stewards.  V/C recieved and passed trial.
